title: UseCase
description: A pre-built shopping use case (e.g. 'Backyard BBQ cookout', 'Weekend trip'). This is template/seed data produced offline by usecase-content-agent, matched to a user by feed-agent, then instantiated per-session as a Scenario by harness-agent. See /docs/schemas/README.md for field-by-field explanation and worked examples.

id.description: Stable unique slug for this use case, e.g. 'backyard-bbq-cookout'. Never reused, never repurposed for a different use case.

title.description: Human-readable name shown to the user, e.g. 'Backyard BBQ Cookout'.

description.description: Optional one- or two-sentence blurb used in match/feed UI copy.

tags.description: Freeform, cross-cutting search/embedding tags (e.g. 'grilling', 'summer', 'kid-friendly'). Independent of the category tree -- used by feed-agent's similarity search, not for taxonomy navigation.

template_list.description: The seed shopping list for this use case. Copied into a new ShoppingList.items[] (as ListItem) when a user starts a Scenario from this UseCase; individual items are then recomputed in place by adjust_scenario as the user patches scenario_slots, never regenerated wholesale.

slot_id.description: Stable identifier for one scenario slot. The six canonical ids (see canonical_slot_id) cover the required axes (time of day, headcount, indoor/outdoor, budget tier, dietary, duration); a UseCase may also define additional use-case-specific slot ids (e.g. 'grill_type') following the same naming pattern.

canonical_slot_id.description: Reserved slot ids with a fixed meaning across every UseCase that uses them. Do not reuse one of these ids for a different meaning.

unit.description: 'event' = a single, non-multi-day occurrence (count is always 1). 'days' = spans multiple days (count = number of days).

duration_value.description: Value shape for the 'duration' slot, representing both the single-event/multi-day distinction and (when multi-day) the actual day count, e.g. { unit: 'event', count: 1 } or { unit: 'days', count: 3 }.

options.description: Common/suggested tags for UI pickers. Not exhaustive -- a Scenario may include additional custom tags at runtime.

slot_definition.description: Defines one entry of UseCase.scenario_slots: the slot's type, its allowed/default value(s), and display metadata. This is the *definition*, not a live value -- see slot_value for what a Scenario stores at runtime.

scenario_slots.description: Map of slot_id -> slot_definition. Declares which of the axes (time_of_day, headcount, setting, budget_tier, dietary, duration, or custom ids) are relevant to this use case, and their allowed range/options/default. A UseCase only needs to declare the slots that actually matter for it -- e.g. a home-setup use case may omit 'duration' entirely. Each key is a stable id that template_list_item.depends_on_slots and Scenario.slots both reference, which is what lets adjust_scenario patch a single slot without touching unrelated items.

slot_value.description: The value shape stored for one slot on a live Scenario (as opposed to slot_definition, which describes the allowed values). Which of these shapes applies for a given slot_id is determined by that slot's type in the originating UseCase.scenario_slots.

oneOf.description: Value for an 'enum' slot, e.g. setting = 'outdoor'.
Value for an 'integer' slot, e.g. headcount = 20.
Value for a 'tag_list' slot, e.g. dietary = ['vegetarian'].

scenario.title: Scenario

slots.description: Current resolved value per slot for this session, keyed the same way as the originating UseCase.scenario_slots. Populated from each slot's default at Scenario creation (with enum/tag_list/budget-tier-like defaults optionally pre-filled from UserMemory -- see README 'Memory boundary'), then patched in place, one slot at a time, by adjust_scenario. Never regenerated wholesale on edit.

scenario.description: The patched/adjusted version of a UseCase for one user session. Deliberately thin: just the live slot values, not a copy of scenario_slots' definitions/options.

base.description: Reference quantity at each dependent slot's default value. Used to seed the ShoppingList when a UseCase is first selected, before any scenario edits.

condition.description: 'equals'/'not_equals' compare against an enum slot's value. 'includes'/'excludes' test membership of value within a tag_list slot's value.

presence_rule.description: One gating condition on a slot's current value, controlling whether an item is included in the list at all. A template_list_item's presence_rules (if more than one) are AND-combined -- the item is included only if every rule is satisfied by the current Scenario.slots.

per_unit.description: Quantity contributed per 1 unit of the referenced slot's numeric value (headcount's integer value, or duration's day count). Total suggested qty = per_unit * slot_value, then rounded per 'round'.

minimum.description: Floor applied after rounding, e.g. never suggest less than 1.

up_to.description: Inclusive upper bound of the slot's numeric value for this tier. null = applies to any value above the previous tier's up_to (must be the last tier).

tiers.description: Ordered ascending by up_to. Use for items that scale in discrete jumps rather than linearly, e.g. coolers: headcount<=10 -> 1, <=25 -> 2, else -> 3.

scaling_rule.description: One formula describing how a numeric/duration slot changes an item's quantity once the item is present. A template_list_item may have zero (static quantity), one, or more than one scaling_rule (e.g. an item can scale with both headcount and duration independently -- suggested qty is computed per rule and summed, unless the item's notes specify otherwise).

item_id.description: Stable id for this item within this UseCase's template_list (not globally unique). Copied to ListItem.source_item_id when the list is instantiated, so adjust_scenario can find and patch the right ShoppingList item by id instead of matching on name.

depends_on_slots.description: Every slot_id whose value affects whether this item is included and/or how much of it is needed. Empty array = a static item unaffected by any slot (e.g. 'grill tongs' -- always present, quantity never changes). Every slot_id referenced in this item's presence_rules or scaling_rules must also appear here, so the harness can compute, from a single changed slot_id, the exact set of items that might need to change without scanning the whole list.

presence_rules.description: Conditions controlling whether this item appears at all. Omitted or empty = always present (subject to scaling_rules).

scaling_rules.description: Quantity formulas, consulted by adjust_scenario when a dependent slot is patched to recompute this item's qty without touching the rest of the list. Omitted = quantity is always qty.base.

list_item.title: ListItem

owned.description: User-marked: they already have this, don't shop for it.

source_item_id.description: The template_list_item.item_id this ListItem was instantiated from, or null if the user added this item manually (not from the template). Used by adjust_scenario to locate which ShoppingList items correspond to which template items when a slot is patched.

list_item.description: One line of a ShoppingList.items[], per CLAUDE.md's canonical ListItem shape. Distinct from template_list_item: this is the live, per-session, user-editable item, not the template it was seeded from.
